releaseNotes:
Mansi Metals ERP v1.0.50:
• Granular RBAC: Sub-permission support for Purchase, Sales, Accounts & Stock under Transactions
• Quick Actions filtered: Quick action buttons now respect individual sub-permissions
• Worker / Helper Auto-Detection: Pure workers automatically open Employee Self-Portal (Attendance, Upad, Salary)
• True Admin vs Staff distinction: Office staff only see permitted modules while Super Admin retains full oversight
